            Moderation (owner only)

            Under each message: 🗑 deletes it, ⚙ Manage opens that person's chat log, timeouts and ban, 🚫 deletes everything they ever posted.

            Chat log for one account

            Song requests (from Kick chat, 250 pts each)

            Open this menu to load requests.

            Or tap ⚙ Manage under any message. From there you can time someone out (1 min, 5 min, 10 min, 30 min, 1 hour) or ban them.

            Clear chat hides everything posted so far for everyone (history is kept safely). Erase all history deletes it for good.

            Chat controls

            Banned words also catch simple tricks like f4ke or spaced-out letters. You are never blocked by this.

            You can also pin any message with 📌 Pin under it. Badges (MOD, VIP, SUB, OG) are set from ⚙ Manage on a person; they are just labels and don’t give powers.

            Sound board (plays on your stream)

            Turn it down if the sounds are too loud on stream, or up (past 100%) if they're too quiet. It changes live on your overlay within a couple of seconds and affects every sound.

            Add any sound, up to 1 GB (MP3 is smallest). Viewers spend site points to play them, only while you are live. Below, you can rename any sound (built-in ones too), change its price, hide or delete it. “Test” plays it on stream for free.

            Announcement bar

            Visitors can close it with the ✕. Posting a new message shows it to everyone again.

            Upload your own emotes

            Only you can upload these. Everyone can use them in chat by typing the name, like :name:. They show up in the ⭐ Ouri tab.
